scripts.schematic: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --schematic-png --ignore-errors
scripts.fab: tsci build index.circuit.tsx && rm -rf fab && mkdir fab && tsci export index.circuit.tsx -f gerbers -o fab/blade-reader.zip && unzip -q fab/blade-reader.zip -d fab/blade-reader
scripts.step: tsci build index.circuit.tsx && mkdir -p fab && tsci export index.circuit.tsx -f step -o fab/blade-reader.step
